questions.stem: A 35-year-old female presents with painless swelling in the umbilical region. On physical examination, the swelling is found to be soft, smooth, and freely mobile in a direction perpendicular to the line of the mesentery. Imaging studies confirm the presence of a mesenteric cyst. Which of the following is not a component of Tillaux's triad?

options.label: A
options.text: Soft, smooth swelling in the umbilical region

options.label: B
options.text: Freely mobile in a direction perpendicular to mesentery
